//: STOCK CONTRACTS (docs/PLAN_demons.md D5, revisited in D6; game/contract.h). Shipped with the game and read-only in the editor; every player can present them. Written to be SAFE AGAINST AN IMP, i.e. against Skerrick's schemes and the duty twists (assets/demons/schemes.json, twists.json): each forbids it attacking you or casting at you (lava under you, a lift and a drop, a claw); each forbids it disturbing its own ring (`cause alters(ring)`: a bound imp still in the circle would otherwise gust its salt open and walk out free, its contract void); every `follow` names its distance (an unset one is the lead-astray twist) and the fetch names its vessel (an unset `into` is the deliver-it-onto-you twist). Each runs one day. NOT safe against a greater demon: Vathrael knows schemes these pages never name (fire beside you, standing where you fall). The language is contract.h's: kind duty | forbid | penalty, a verb, `who` (a selector), `when` (a trigger), `arg`/`into`, `then`, `on`.
